response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS stn_avg FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(stn_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM st) AS station_fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage

assumptions.assumption: Stations counted (in each phase and in the total) are those that have at least one telescope, because the inner join keeps only matched pairs. Stations whose telescopes all have a missing bandwidth usage still count as stations but add nothing to the average.
A missing phase means a NULL lunarstage, and NULL forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count every observatory station, including those with no telescopes, in the station count and in the fraction's denominator. The average is still taken over stations that have telescopes.
